LinkedIn.About:
An image is not always the most robust route to inference.

I am a PhD student at Xi'an Jiaotong University. I study reliable sensing under limited sampling and measurement noise, connecting optical measurement design, image reconstruction and direct inference from single-pixel measurements. In single-pixel segmentation, my work shows when inference directly from measurements is more robust than reconstructing images first, with all models trained on clean data.

I now work on time-domain diffuse optical tomography for brain imaging, inferring 3D distributions of optical properties from photon time-of-flight measurements. My long-term aim is to help robots interpret the physical world from raw measurements and physical models.

My background includes electro-optic device modeling and optical-system integration. I develop open-source tools for research experiments and review for computational imaging and optics journals.

I welcome research collaborations and internships that combine measurements and physical models to help machines learn and reason reliably, with applications in scientific discovery and embodied systems.
LinkedIn.About (Chinese profile):
先重建图像，未必是最稳健的推断路径。

我是西安交通大学博士研究生。我研究如何在有限采样与测量噪声下实现可靠感知，将光学测量设计、图像重建与单像素测量的直接推断联系起来。在单像素分割中，我的工作揭示了直接推断何时比先重建图像更抗噪；比较中的模型均以无噪声数据训练。

目前，我正开展面向脑部成像的时域漫射光学层析研究，从光子飞行时间测量中推断光学性质的三维分布。长期希望让机器人结合原始测量与物理模型，理解周围的物理世界。

我也具备电光器件建模与光学系统集成经验，开发服务科研实验的开源工具，并担任计算成像与光学期刊审稿人。

欢迎交流研究合作与科研实习机会，共同探索如何结合测量数据与物理模型，让机器更可靠地学习和推理，服务科学发现与具身智能。
